subject.title: feat(browser): add GPT-5.6 Sol model aliases

question: Should Oracle expose `gpt-5.6` as a moving alias for the current GPT-5.6 browser default while keeping `gpt-5.6-sol` permanently pinned to the Sol picker entry?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but current main does not establish whether a public model alias may intentionally retarget existing users in future releases.

options.title: Adopt moving and pinned aliases
options.body: Merge both names with `gpt-5.6` tracking the current GPT-5.6 default and `gpt-5.6-sol` retaining stable Sol semantics.

options.title: Ship only the pinned alias
options.body: Expose `gpt-5.6-sol` now and defer the generic alias until maintainers define a repository-wide moving-alias policy.

options.title: Defer first-class aliases
options.body: Continue supporting explicit ChatGPT labels until GPT-5.6 naming and picker behavior stabilize further.

recommendation.title: Adopt moving and pinned aliases
recommendation.body: Merge both names with `gpt-5.6` tracking the current GPT-5.6 default and `gpt-5.6-sol` retaining stable Sol semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns most of the current browser model-routing history and is the strongest available owner for the public compatibility decision.
